import math
import minstd = "./minstd.qui"
import road = "./road.qui"
import vehicles = "./vehicles.qui"
import signals = "./signals.qui"
import stats = "./stats.qui"

string time_text(int value)
    return "{value:04.}"

string flag(bool value)
    return if value then "Y" else "N"

string optional(int value)
    return if value == 0 then "-" else string(value)

int lookup(map<string, int> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return -1

string[] lookup_lines(map<int, string[]> values, int key)
    match values.get(key)
        string[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

int[] integers(string[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        result = result.append(int(value))
    return result

int total(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

class Ratio(local int top, local bottom := 1)
    local divisor := stats.gcd(top, bottom)
    int numerator := top / divisor
    int denominator := bottom / divisor

    Ratio times(int weight, int weight_sum)
        return Ratio(numerator * weight, denominator * weight_sum)

    Ratio plus(Ratio other)
        common := stats.gcd(denominator, other.denominator)
        return Ratio(numerator * (other.denominator / common) + other.numerator * (denominator / common), denominator / common * other.denominator)

    string text()
        return "{numerator}/{denominator}"

class Route(int[] segments, Ratio share)
class Period(int value, int until)

class Source(string node, Period[] periods, int entry)
    int[] queue := []
    head := 0
    queue_start := 0
    queue_max := 0

    int count()
        return int(#queue) - head

    int rate(int time_step)
        for period := periods[]
            if time_step <= period.until
                return period.value
        return 0

class Detector(string name, int segment, int cell, int width)

class Diagram(int segment, int lane, int start, int end)
    string[] lines := []

class Ring(int number, int length, int vmax, int warmup, int measure, int seed, int[] counts)

class Interval(local int detector_count)
    arrivals := 0
    insertions := 0
    exits := 0
    vehicle_steps := 0
    speed_sum := 0
    passing := array(nat(detector_count), fill = 0)
    occupancy := array(nat(detector_count), fill = 0)
    occupancy_speed := array(nat(detector_count), fill = 0)

class Move(int vehicle, int segment, int cell, speed := 0)
class Change(int vehicle, int lane, int kind)

int run_ring(Ring experiment, int count, int moving, int stopped)
    rng := minstd.Generator(experiment.seed)
    int[] positions := []
    for: index < count
        positions = positions.append(index * experiment.length / count)
    speeds := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    measured := 0
    for: 1 <= time_step <= experiment.warmup + experiment.measure
        occupants := array(nat(experiment.length), fill = -1)
        for: index < count
            occupants[positions[index]] = index
        ordered := positions.sorted(descending = true)
        next_speeds := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
        for: rank < count
            position := ordered[rank]
            index := occupants[position]
            ahead := ordered[(rank + count - 1) % count]
            gap := (ahead - position - 1 + experiment.length) % experiment.length
            accelerated := math.min(math.min(speeds[index] + 1, experiment.vmax), gap)
            next_speeds[index] = vehicles.random_slowdown(accelerated, speeds[index], .rng.draw(), moving, stopped)
        for: index < count
            positions[index] = (positions[index] + next_speeds[index]) % experiment.length
        speeds = next_speeds
        if time_step > experiment.warmup
            measured += total(next_speeds)
    return measured

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    if not file.is_directory("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(text)

class Simulation()
    road.Segment[] network := []
    network_by_id := map<string, int>()
    signals.Junction[] junctions := []
    road.Incident[] incidents := []
    road.BusStop[] bus_stops := []
    vehicles.VehicleClass[] kinds := []
    Source[] sources := []
    string[] sinks := []
    seed := 1
    step_count := 0
    moving_probability := 0
    stopped_probability := 0
    interval_size := 1
    bin_width := 1
    Detector[] detectors := []
    Diagram[] diagrams := []
    int[] tracked_numbers := []
    Ring[] rings := []
    generator := minstd.Generator(1)
    vehicles.Vehicle[] fleet := []
    Interval[] intervals := []
    string[] events := []
    trajectories := map<int, string[]>()

    void .load()
        for filename := ["network.txt", "demand.txt", "params.txt"][]
            string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + filename))
            for line := text.split(NL)[]
                if line == ""
                    continue
                fields := line.split(" ")
                command := fields[0]
                if command == "SEGMENT"
                    .network_by_id.set(fields[1], int(#network))
                    network = network.append(road.Segment(fields[1], fields[2], fields[3], int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), int(fields[6])))
                elif command == "JUNCTION"
                    junction_index := int(#junctions)
                    junctions = junctions.append(signals.Junction(fields[1], int(fields[2]), fields[3:<#fields]))
                    for: section_index < #network
                        if network[section_index].to_node == fields[1]
                            network[section_index].junction = junction_index
                elif command == "INCIDENT"
                    incidents = incidents.append(road.Incident(lookup(network_by_id, fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5])))
                elif command == "STOP"
                    section_index := lookup(network_by_id, fields[1])
                    network[section_index].stop = int(#bus_stops)
                    bus_stops = bus_stops.append(road.BusStop(section_index, int(fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
                elif command == "CLASS"
                    kinds = kinds.append(vehicles.VehicleClass(fields[1], int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), fields[4] == "Y", fields[5] == "Y"))
                elif command == "SOURCE"
                    Period[] schedule := []
                    for: 2 <= position < int(#fields)
                        pair := fields[position].split(":")
                        schedule = schedule.append(Period(int(pair[0]), int(pair[1])))
                    entry_index := -1
                    for: section_index < #network
                        if network[section_index].from_node == fields[1]
                            entry_index = int(section_index)
                    sources = sources.append(Source(fields[1], schedule, entry_index))
                elif command == "SINK"
                    sinks = sinks.append(fields[1])
                elif command == "TURN"
                    section_index := lookup(network_by_id, fields[1])
                    network[section_index].turns = network[section_index].turns.append(road.Turn(lookup(network_by_id, fields[2]), int(fields[3])))
                elif command == "seed"
                    seed = int(fields[1])
                elif command == "steps"
                    step_count = int(fields[1])
                elif command == "dawdle"
                    moving_probability = int(fields[1])
                    stopped_probability = int(fields[2])
                elif command == "interval"
                    interval_size = int(fields[1])
                elif command == "bin"
                    bin_width = int(fields[1])
                elif command == "detector"
                    detectors = detectors.append(Detector(fields[1], lookup(network_by_id, fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4])))
                elif command == "diagram"
                    diagrams = diagrams.append(Diagram(lookup(network_by_id, fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4])))
                elif command == "track"
                    tracked_numbers = integers(fields[1:<#fields])
                    for number := tracked_numbers[]
                        .trajectories.set(number, [])
                elif command == "ring"
                    rings = rings.append(Ring(int(#rings) + 1, int(fields[1]), int(fields[2]), int(fields[3]), int(fields[4]), int(fields[5]), integers(fields[6:<#fields])))

    void .record(int time_step, string text)
        events = events.append(time_text(time_step) + " " + text)

    int[] present(int section_index)
        int[] result := []
        for: 1 <= lane_number <= network[section_index].lanes
            for number := network[section_index].vehicle_numbers(lane_number)[]
                result = result.append(number - 1)
        return result

    bool heading(int vehicle_index)
        current := fleet[vehicle_index]
        if current.segment < 0
            return false
        stop_index := network[current.segment].stop
        stop_cell := if stop_index >= 0 then bus_stops[stop_index].cell else -1
        return current.heading_for_stop(kinds[current.kind].stops, stop_cell)

    void .enter(int vehicle_index, int section_index)
        fleet[vehicle_index].route = fleet[vehicle_index].route.append(section_index)
        network[section_index].entered += 1
        if network[section_index].junction >= 0
            int[] weights := []
            for turn := network[section_index].turns[]
                weights = weights.append(turn.weight)
            fleet[vehicle_index].turn = minstd.select(weights, .generator.draw())

    void .arrive(int time_step)
        interval_index := int(#intervals) - 1
        int[] weights := []
        for kind := kinds[]
            weights = weights.append(kind.weight)
        for: source_index < #sources
            if .generator.draw() % 1000 < sources[source_index].rate(time_step)
                class_index := minstd.select(weights, .generator.draw())
                vehicle_index := int(#fleet)
                fleet = fleet.append(vehicles.Vehicle(vehicle_index + 1, class_index, int(source_index), time_step))
                sources[source_index].queue = sources[source_index].queue.append(vehicle_index)
                intervals[interval_index].arrivals += 1

    void .insert(int time_step)
        interval_index := int(#intervals) - 1
        for: source_index < #sources
            section_index := sources[source_index].entry
            while sources[source_index].count() > 0
                desired := 0
                best := -1
                for: 1 <= lane_number <= network[section_index].lanes
                    if network[section_index].cells[lane_number - 1][0] == 0
                        first_cell := network[section_index].first(lane_number)
                        if first_cell > best
                            desired = lane_number
                            best = first_cell
                if desired == 0
                    break
                vehicle_index := sources[source_index].queue[sources[source_index].head]
                sources[source_index].head += 1
                .fleet[vehicle_index].place(&network, section_index, desired, 0)
                fleet[vehicle_index].inserted = time_step
                .enter(vehicle_index, section_index)
                intervals[interval_index].insertions += 1
            waiting := sources[source_index].count()
            if waiting > 0 and sources[source_index].queue_start == 0
                sources[source_index].queue_start = time_step
                sources[source_index].queue_max = 0
            if sources[source_index].queue_start != 0
                sources[source_index].queue_max = math.max(sources[source_index].queue_max, waiting)
                if waiting == 0
                    .record(time_step, "QUEUE {sources[source_index].node} from {sources[source_index].queue_start} max {sources[source_index].queue_max}")
                    sources[source_index].queue_start = 0

    Change desired_lane(int vehicle_index)
        current := fleet[vehicle_index]
        section := network[current.segment]
        lane_number := current.lane
        position := current.cell
        maximum := current.maximum(kinds[current.kind].vmax, section.limit)
        here := section.free(lane_number, position, maximum + 1)
        wanted := math.min(current.speed + 1, maximum)
        ahead := position + here + 1
        if here < maximum + 1 and ahead < section.length and section.cells[lane_number - 1][ahead] == -1
            for target := [lane_number + 1, lane_number - 1][]
                if 1 <= target <= section.lanes and section.free(target, position, maximum + 1) > here and section.safe(target, position)
                    return Change(vehicle_index, target, 2)
        if heading(vehicle_index)
            target := if lane_number >= 2 and section.safe(lane_number - 1, position) then lane_number - 1 else lane_number
            return Change(vehicle_index, target, 1)
        if kinds[current.kind].overtakes and lane_number < section.lanes and here < wanted and section.free(lane_number + 1, position, maximum + 1) > here and section.safe(lane_number + 1, position)
            return Change(vehicle_index, lane_number + 1, 0)
        if lane_number >= 2 and section.free(lane_number - 1, position, maximum + 1) > wanted and section.safe(lane_number - 1, position)
            return Change(vehicle_index, lane_number - 1, 1)
        return Change(vehicle_index, lane_number, 0)

    void .change_lanes()
        Change[] pending := []
        for: section_index < #network
            if network[section_index].lanes < 2
                continue
            distinct<int> reserved
            for: 1 <= lane_number <= network[section_index].lanes
                for number := network[section_index].vehicle_numbers(lane_number)[]
                    vehicle_index := number - 1
                    if fleet[vehicle_index].dwell > 0
                        continue
                    Change choice := desired_lane(vehicle_index)
                    key := choice.lane * network[section_index].length + fleet[vehicle_index].cell
                    if choice.lane != lane_number and not reserved.has(key)
                        .reserved.add(key)
                        pending = pending.append(choice)
        for choice := pending[]
            section_index := fleet[choice.vehicle].segment
            position := fleet[choice.vehicle].cell
            .fleet[choice.vehicle].place(&network, section_index, choice.lane, position)
            fleet[choice.vehicle].lane_changes += 1
            network[section_index].changes[choice.kind] += 1

    Move[] processing_order()
        Move[] result := []
        for: section_index < #network
            for: 1 <= lane_number <= network[section_index].lanes
                numbers := network[section_index].vehicle_numbers(lane_number)
                for number := numbers[::-1][]
                    result = result.append(Move(number - 1, int(section_index), fleet[number - 1].cell))
        return result

    int .determine_speed(int vehicle_index, int time_step)
        current := fleet[vehicle_index]
        section := network[current.segment]
        accelerated := math.min(current.speed + 1, current.maximum(kinds[current.kind].vmax, section.limit))
        gap := section.free(current.lane, current.cell, accelerated)
        if gap < accelerated and current.cell + gap == section.length - 1
            if section.junction < 0
                gap = accelerated
            elif junctions[section.junction].green(section.id, time_step)
                target := network[section.turns[current.turn].target]
                gap += target.free(math.min(current.lane, target.lanes), -1, accelerated - gap)
        if heading(vehicle_index)
            gap = math.min(gap, bus_stops[section.stop].cell - current.cell)
        updated := vehicles.random_slowdown(math.min(accelerated, gap), current.speed, .generator.draw(), moving_probability, stopped_probability)
        if current.dwell > 0
            updated = 0
            fleet[vehicle_index].dwell -= 1
        return updated

    void .move_all(Move[] &movements, int time_step)
        int[] passing := []
        interval_index := int(#intervals) - 1
        for: move_index < #movements
            movement := movements[move_index]
            vehicle_index := movement.vehicle
            section := network[movement.segment]
            if movement.cell + movement.speed < section.length
                .fleet[vehicle_index].place(&network, movement.segment, fleet[vehicle_index].lane, movement.cell + movement.speed)
            elif section.junction < 0
                .fleet[vehicle_index].leave(&network)
                fleet[vehicle_index].exited = time_step
                fleet[vehicle_index].sink = section.to_node
                intervals[interval_index].exits += 1
            else
                passing = passing.append(int(move_index))
        for move_index := passing[]
            movement := movements[move_index]
            vehicle_index := movement.vehicle
            section_index := movement.segment
            turn_index := fleet[vehicle_index].turn
            int target_index := network[section_index].turns[turn_index].target
            target_lane := math.min(fleet[vehicle_index].lane, network[target_index].lanes)
            overshoot := movement.cell + movement.speed - network[section_index].length
            target_cell := math.min(overshoot, network[target_index].first(target_lane) - 1)
            if target_cell < overshoot
                network[section_index].blocked += 1
            if target_cell >= 0
                .fleet[vehicle_index].place(&network, target_index, target_lane, target_cell)
                movements[move_index].speed = network[section_index].length - movement.cell + target_cell
                network[section_index].passed += 1
                network[section_index].turns[turn_index].vehicles += 1
                .enter(vehicle_index, target_index)
            else
                .fleet[vehicle_index].place(&network, section_index, fleet[vehicle_index].lane, network[section_index].length - 1)
                movements[move_index].speed = network[section_index].length - 1 - movement.cell

    void .aggregate_vehicle(Move movement, int time_step)
        vehicle_index := movement.vehicle
        interval_index := int(#intervals) - 1
        updated := movement.speed
        fleet[vehicle_index].network_steps += 1
        fleet[vehicle_index].distance += updated
        if updated == 0
            fleet[vehicle_index].stopped_steps += 1
            if fleet[vehicle_index].speed > 0
                fleet[vehicle_index].stop_count += 1
        fleet[vehicle_index].speed = updated
        intervals[interval_index].vehicle_steps += 1
        intervals[interval_index].speed_sum += updated
        if heading(vehicle_index) and fleet[vehicle_index].lane == 1
            section_index := fleet[vehicle_index].segment
            stop_index := network[section_index].stop
            if fleet[vehicle_index].cell == bus_stops[stop_index].cell
                .fleet[vehicle_index].completed_stops.add(section_index)
                fleet[vehicle_index].dwell = bus_stops[stop_index].dwell
                bus_stops[stop_index].buses += 1
                .record(time_step, "BUS_STOP {fleet[vehicle_index].number} {network[section_index].id} cell {bus_stops[stop_index].cell}")
        current := fleet[vehicle_index]
        if trajectories.has(current.number)
            detail := if current.segment < 0 then "EXIT {current.speed}" else "{network[current.segment].id} {current.lane} {current.cell} {current.speed}"
            lines := lookup_lines(trajectories, current.number).append(time_text(time_step) + " " + detail)
            .trajectories.set(current.number, lines)
        for: detector_index < #detectors
            probe := detectors[detector_index]
            if movement.segment == probe.segment and movement.cell < probe.cell and (current.segment != probe.segment or current.cell >= probe.cell)
                intervals[interval_index].passing[detector_index] += 1

    void .aggregate_state(int time_step)
        interval_index := int(#intervals) - 1
        for: detector_index < #detectors
            probe := detectors[detector_index]
            for vehicle_index := present(probe.segment)[]
                if probe.cell <= fleet[vehicle_index].cell < probe.cell + probe.width
                    intervals[interval_index].occupancy[detector_index] += 1
                    intervals[interval_index].occupancy_speed[detector_index] += fleet[vehicle_index].speed
        for: section_index < #network
            int[] occupants := present(int(section_index))
            count := int(#occupants)
            summed_speed := 0
            waiting := 0
            for vehicle_index := occupants[]
                summed_speed += fleet[vehicle_index].speed
                if fleet[vehicle_index].speed == 0
                    waiting += 1
            network[section_index].vehicle_sum += count
            network[section_index].speed_sum += summed_speed
            network[section_index].max_vehicles = math.max(network[section_index].max_vehicles, count)
            junction_index := network[section_index].junction
            if junction_index >= 0
                green_now := junctions[junction_index].green(network[section_index].id, time_step)
                if green_now
                    network[section_index].green_steps += 1
                network[section_index].queue_sum += waiting
                network[section_index].max_queue = math.max(network[section_index].max_queue, waiting)
                if time_step < step_count and waiting > 0 and green_now and not junctions[junction_index].green(network[section_index].id, time_step + 1)
                    network[section_index].failures += 1
        for: diagram_index < #diagrams
            picture := diagrams[diagram_index]
            if picture.start <= time_step <= picture.end
                section := network[picture.segment]
                speeds := array(nat(section.length), fill = 0)
                for: position < section.length
                    number := section.cells[picture.lane - 1][position]
                    if number > 0
                        speeds[position] = fleet[number - 1].speed
                signal_text := if section.junction < 0 then "E" elif junctions[section.junction].green(section.id, time_step) then "G" else "R"
                line := time_text(time_step) + " " + section.cells_text(picture.lane, speeds) + " " + signal_text
                diagrams[diagram_index].lines = diagrams[diagram_index].lines.append(line)

    void .run()
        generator = minstd.Generator(seed)
        for: 1 <= time_step <= step_count
            for: incident_index < #incidents
                section_index := incidents[incident_index].segment
                event := .incidents[incident_index].update(&network[section_index], time_step)
                if event != ""
                    occurrence := incidents[incident_index]
                    .record(time_step, "{event} {network[section_index].id} lane {occurrence.lane} cell {occurrence.cell}")
            if (time_step - 1) % interval_size == 0
                intervals = intervals.append(Interval(int(#detectors)))
            .arrive(time_step)
            .insert(time_step)
            .change_lanes()
            Move[] movements := processing_order()
            for: move_index < #movements
                movements[move_index].speed = .determine_speed(movements[move_index].vehicle, time_step)
            .move_all(&movements, time_step)
            for movement := movements[]
                .aggregate_vehicle(movement, time_step)
            .aggregate_state(time_step)
        for origin := sources[]
            if origin.queue_start != 0
                .record(step_count, "QUEUE {origin.node} from {origin.queue_start} max {origin.queue_max} open")

    Route[] enumerate_routes(int section_index)
        section := network[section_index]
        if section.junction < 0
            return [Route([section_index], Ratio(1))]
        weight_sum := 0
        for turn := section.turns[]
            weight_sum += turn.weight
        Route[] result := []
        for turn := section.turns[]
            for option := enumerate_routes(turn.target)[]
                result = result.append(Route([section_index].concat(option.segments), option.share.times(turn.weight, weight_sum)))
        return result

    string segment_names(int[] indices, string separator)
        string[] result := []
        for index := indices[]
            result = result.append(network[index].id)
        return result.join(separator)

    int[] exited_indices()
        int[] result := []
        for: index < #fleet
            if fleet[index].exited != 0
                result = result.append(int(index))
        return result

    int[] class_indices(int class_index, only_exited := false)
        int[] result := []
        for: index < #fleet
            if fleet[index].kind == class_index and (not only_exited or fleet[index].exited != 0)
                result = result.append(int(index))
        return result

    string[] travel_block(string heading_text, int[] group)
        int[] times := []
        for index := group[]
            times = times.append(fleet[index].travel_time())
        times = times.sorted()
        count := int(#times)
        if count == 0
            return ["{heading_text} exited 0"]
        first_line := "{heading_text} exited {count} min {times[0]} p50 {stats.percentile(times, 50)} p90 {stats.percentile(times, 90)} max {times[count - 1]} mean {stats.decimal(total(times), count, 2)}"
        return [first_line].concat(stats.histogram(times, bin_width))

    string outcome(int[] group, int overall)
        summed_time := 0
        for index := group[]
            summed_time += fleet[index].travel_time()
        count := int(#group)
        return "vehicles {count} share {stats.fraction(count, overall)} mean {stats.decimal(summed_time, count, 2)}"

    string[] source_lines(int source_index, int[] exited_group)
        origin := sources[source_index]
        int[] group := []
        for index := exited_group[]
            if fleet[index].source == source_index
                group = group.append(index)
        count := int(#group)
        result := ["SOURCE {origin.node} exited {count}"]
        Route[] options := enumerate_routes(origin.entry)
        for option := options[]
            int[] matched := []
            for index := group[]
                if fleet[index].route == option.segments
                    matched = matched.append(index)
            string names := segment_names(option.segments, ",")
            result = result.append("  ROUTE {names} expected {option.share.text()} " + outcome(matched, count))
        for destination := sinks[]
            expected := Ratio(0)
            reachable := false
            for option := options[]
                last_index := option.segments[-1]
                if network[last_index].to_node == destination
                    reachable = true
                    expected = expected.plus(option.share)
            if reachable
                int[] matched := []
                for index := group[]
                    if fleet[index].sink == destination
                        matched = matched.append(index)
                result = result.append("  SINK {destination} expected {expected.text()} " + outcome(matched, count))
        return result

    string[] travel_lines()
        string[] result := []
        for: class_index < #kinds
            result = result.concat(travel_block("CLASS " + kinds[class_index].name, class_indices(int(class_index), true)))
        int[] exited_group := exited_indices()
        result = result.concat(travel_block("ALL", exited_group))
        for: source_index < #sources
            result = result.concat(source_lines(int(source_index), exited_group))
        return result

    string[] class_block(string heading_text, int[] group)
        inserted_count := 0
        exited_count := 0
        summed_steps := 0
        summed_distance := 0
        summed_time := 0
        summed_delay := 0
        summed_stopped := 0
        summed_stops := 0
        summed_changes := 0
        for index := group[]
            current := fleet[index]
            if current.inserted != 0
                inserted_count += 1
            summed_steps += current.network_steps
            summed_distance += current.distance
            if current.exited != 0
                exited_count += 1
                summed_time += current.travel_time()
                summed_delay += current.inserted - current.arrival
                summed_stopped += current.stopped_steps
                summed_stops += current.stop_count
                summed_changes += current.lane_changes
        generated := int(#group)
        return [
            heading_text,
            "  generated {generated} inserted {inserted_count} exited {exited_count} in_network {inserted_count - exited_count} queued {generated - inserted_count}",
            "  vehicle_steps {summed_steps} distance {summed_distance} mean_speed {stats.fraction(summed_distance, summed_steps)} = {stats.decimal(summed_distance, summed_steps, 3)}",
            "  travel {stats.decimal(summed_time, exited_count, 2)} entry_delay {stats.decimal(summed_delay, exited_count, 2)} stopped {stats.decimal(summed_stopped, exited_count, 2)} stops {stats.decimal(summed_stops, exited_count, 2)} lane_changes {stats.decimal(summed_changes, exited_count, 2)}",
        ]

    string[] class_lines()
        string[] result := []
        for: class_index < #kinds
            kind := kinds[class_index]
            heading_text := "CLASS {kind.name} vmax {kind.vmax} weight {kind.weight} overtake {flag(kind.overtakes)} stops {flag(kind.stops)}"
            result = result.concat(class_block(heading_text, class_indices(int(class_index))))
        int[] everyone := []
        for: index < #fleet
            everyone = everyone.append(int(index))
        return result.concat(class_block("ALL", everyone))

    string[] network_lines()
        string[] result := []
        for section := network[]
            string[] change_counts := []
            for count := section.changes[]
                change_counts = change_counts.append(string(count))
            changes_text := change_counts.join("/")
            result = result.append("SEGMENT {section.id} {section.from_node} {section.to_node} length {section.length} lanes {section.lanes} limit {section.limit} entered {section.entered} mean_vehicles {stats.decimal(section.vehicle_sum, step_count, 3)} density {stats.decimal(section.vehicle_sum, step_count * section.length * section.lanes, 4)} mean_speed {stats.decimal(section.speed_sum, section.vehicle_sum, 2)} max_vehicles {section.max_vehicles} changes {changes_text}")
        for: junction_index < #junctions
            result = result.concat(junctions[junction_index].plan_lines())
            for section := network[]
                if section.junction != int(junction_index)
                    continue
                result = result.append("  IN {section.id} green {section.green_steps} passed {section.passed} blocked {section.blocked} max_queue {section.max_queue} mean_queue {stats.decimal(section.queue_sum, step_count, 3)} failures {section.failures}")
                for turn := section.turns[]
                    result = result.append("    TURN {network[turn.target].id} weight {turn.weight} vehicles {turn.vehicles}")
        for stop_entry := bus_stops[]
            result = result.append("STOP {network[stop_entry.segment].id} cell {stop_entry.cell} dwell {stop_entry.dwell} buses {stop_entry.buses}")
        for occurrence := incidents[]
            active_text := if occurrence.active_start == 0 then "none" else "{occurrence.active_start}-{occurrence.active_end}"
            result = result.append("INCIDENT {network[occurrence.segment].id} lane {occurrence.lane} cell {occurrence.cell} planned {occurrence.start}-{occurrence.end} active {active_text}")
        return result

    string[] spacetime_lines()
        string[] result := []
        for picture := diagrams[]
            result = result.append("DIAGRAM {network[picture.segment].id} lane {picture.lane} steps {picture.start}-{picture.end}").concat(picture.lines)
        return result

    string[] detector_lines()
        result := ["detector,interval,flow,density,speed"]
        for: detector_index < #detectors
            probe := detectors[detector_index]
            capacity := interval_size * probe.width * network[probe.segment].lanes
            for: interval_index < #intervals
                block := intervals[interval_index]
                int occupied := block.occupancy[detector_index]
                result = result.append("{probe.name},{interval_index + 1},{block.passing[detector_index]},{stats.decimal(occupied, capacity, 4)},{stats.decimal(block.occupancy_speed[detector_index], occupied, 2)}")
        return result

    string[] timeline_lines()
        result := ["interval,arrived,inserted,exited,in_network,queued,mean_speed"]
        arrived_count := 0
        inserted_count := 0
        exited_count := 0
        for: interval_index < #intervals
            block := intervals[interval_index]
            arrived_count += block.arrivals
            inserted_count += block.insertions
            exited_count += block.exits
            result = result.append("{interval_index + 1},{block.arrivals},{block.insertions},{block.exits},{inserted_count - exited_count},{arrived_count - inserted_count},{stats.decimal(block.speed_sum, block.vehicle_steps, 2)}")
        return result

    string[] track_lines()
        string[] result := []
        for number := tracked_numbers[]
            if number > int(#fleet)
                result = result.append("VEHICLE {number} none")
                continue
            current := fleet[number - 1]
            result = result.append("VEHICLE {number} class {kinds[current.kind].name} source {sources[current.source].node} arrival {current.arrival} inserted {optional(current.inserted)} exited {optional(current.exited)} sink {current.sink}")
            string route_text := if #current.route == 0 then "-" else segment_names(current.route, " ")
            result = result.append("ROUTE " + route_text).concat(lookup_lines(trajectories, number))
        return result

    string[] fundamental_lines()
        result := ["ring,vehicles,density,flow,speed"]
        for experiment := rings[]
            for count := experiment.counts[]
                measured := run_ring(experiment, count, moving_probability, stopped_probability)
                result = result.append("{experiment.number},{count},{stats.decimal(count, experiment.length, 4)},{stats.decimal(measured, experiment.length * experiment.measure, 4)},{stats.decimal(measured, count * experiment.measure, 3)}")
        return result

    void write_reports()
        write_lines("spacetime.txt", spacetime_lines())
        write_lines("detectors.csv", detector_lines())
        write_lines("travel_times.txt", travel_lines())
        write_lines("class_stats.txt", class_lines())
        write_lines("network_stats.txt", network_lines())
        write_lines("timeline.csv", timeline_lines())
        write_lines("tracks.txt", track_lines())
        write_lines("fundamental.csv", fundamental_lines())
        write_lines("events.txt", events)

if main
    simulation := Simulation()
    .simulation.load()
    .simulation.run()
    simulation.write_reports()

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = state * 48271 % 2147483647
        return state

int select(int[] weights, int random_value)
    total := 0
    for weight := weights[]
        total += weight
    value := random_value % total
    cumulative := 0
    for: index < #weights
        cumulative += weights[index]
        if value < cumulative
            return int(index)
    return int(#weights) - 1

class Turn(int target, int weight)
    vehicles := 0

class BusStop(int segment, int cell, int dwell)
    buses := 0

class Segment(string id, string from_node, string to_node, int length, int lanes, int limit)
    int[][] cells := array(nat(lanes), fill = array(nat(length), fill = 0))
    junction := -1
    Turn[] turns := []
    stop := -1
    entered := 0
    vehicle_sum := 0
    speed_sum := 0
    max_vehicles := 0
    green_steps := 0
    queue_sum := 0
    max_queue := 0
    failures := 0
    passed := 0
    blocked := 0
    changes := [0, 0, 0]

    void .put(int lane_number, int cell_number, int value)
        cells[lane_number - 1][cell_number] = value

    int free(int lane_number, int cell_number, int cap)
        count := 0
        while count < cap and cell_number + count + 1 < length and cells[lane_number - 1][cell_number + count + 1] == 0
            count += 1
        return count

    int first(int lane_number)
        for: position < length
            if cells[lane_number - 1][position] != 0
                return position
        return length

    bool safe(int lane_number, int cell_number)
        for: math.max(0, cell_number - limit) <= position <= cell_number
            if cells[lane_number - 1][position] != 0
                return false
        return true

    int[] vehicle_numbers(int lane_number)
        int[] result := []
        for value := cells[lane_number - 1][]
            if value > 0
                result = result.append(value)
        return result

    string cells_text(int lane_number, int[] speeds)
        result := ""
        for: position < length
            value := cells[lane_number - 1][position]
            result += if value == 0 then "." elif value == -1 then "#" else string(speeds[position])
        return result

class Incident(int segment, int lane, int cell, int start, int end)
    state := "planned"
    active_start := 0
    active_end := 0

    string .update(Segment &section, int time_step)
        event := ""
        if state == "active" and time_step > end
            state = "cleared"
            .section.put(lane, cell, 0)
            event = "INCIDENT_END"
        elif state == "planned" and time_step > end
            state = "cancelled"
        elif state == "planned" and time_step >= start and section.cells[lane - 1][cell] == 0
            state = "active"
            .section.put(lane, cell, -1)
            active_start = time_step
            event = "INCIDENT_START"
        if state == "active"
            active_end = time_step
        return event

class Phase(local string text)
    local fields := text.split(":")
    duration := int(fields[0])
    string token := fields[1]
    greens := distinct<string>()
    if token != "-"
        for segment_id := token.split(",")[]
            .greens.add(segment_id)

class Junction(string node, int offset, local string[] tokens)
    Phase[] phases := []
    cycle := 0
    for token := tokens[]
        phase := Phase(token)
        phases = phases.append(phase)
        cycle += phase.duration

    bool green(string segment_id, int time_step)
        if #phases == 0
            return true
        elapsed := (time_step - 1 + offset) % cycle
        for entry := phases[]
            if elapsed < entry.duration
                return entry.greens.has(segment_id)
            elapsed -= entry.duration
        return false

    string[] plan_lines()
        if #phases == 0
            return ["JUNCTION {node} unsignalized"]
        result := ["JUNCTION {node} signal cycle {cycle} offset {offset}"]
        begin := 0
        for: index < #phases
            entry := phases[index]
            result = result.append("  PHASE {index + 1} {begin}-{begin + entry.duration - 1} {entry.token}")
            begin += entry.duration
        return result

int gcd(int first, int second)
    left := first
    right := second
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

string decimal(int numerator, int denominator, int places)
    if denominator == 0
        return "-"
    scale := 1
    for: digit < places
        scale *= 10
    value := (2 * numerator * scale + denominator) / (2 * denominator)
    tail := string(value % scale)
    return "{value / scale}." + "0" * nat(places - int(#tail)) + tail

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    if denominator == 0
        return "-"
    divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    return "{numerator / divisor}/{denominator / divisor}"

int percentile(int[] times, int q)
    return times[(q * int(#times) + 99) / 100 - 1]

string[] histogram(int[] times, int width)
    first := times[0] / width
    counts := array(nat(times[-1] / width - first + 1), fill = 0)
    for value := times[]
        counts[value / width - first] += 1
    maximum := 0
    for frequency := counts[]
        if frequency > maximum
            maximum = frequency
    string[] result := []
    for: index < #counts
        lower := (first + int(index)) * width
        frequency := counts[index]
        stars := (80 * frequency + maximum) / (2 * maximum)
        line := "  {lower}-{lower + width - 1} {frequency}"
        if stars > 0
            line += " " + "*" * nat(stars)
        result = result.append(line)
    return result

class Vehicle(int number, int kind, int source, int arrival)
    inserted := 0
    exited := 0
    sink := "-"

    cell := 0
    speed := 0
    turn := -1
    int[] route := []
    network_steps := 0

    stopped_steps := 0
    stop_count := 0
    lane_changes := 0
    dwell := 0

    int maximum(int class_limit, int segment_limit)
        return math.min(class_limit, segment_limit)

    void .place(road.Segment[] &network, int destination, int target_lane, int target_cell)
        if segment >= 0
            .network[segment].put(lane, cell, 0)
        .network[destination].put(target_lane, target_cell, number)
        segment = destination
        lane = target_lane
        cell = target_cell

    void .leave(road.Segment[] &network)
        .network[segment].put(lane, cell, 0)
        segment = -1

    bool heading_for_stop(bool class_stops, int stop_cell)
        return segment >= 0 and class_stops and stop_cell >= 0 and not completed_stops.has(segment) and cell <= stop_cell

    int travel_time()
        return exited - inserted + 1

int random_slowdown(int speed, int previous, int random_value, int moving, int stopped)
    probability := if previous == 0 then stopped else moving
    return if speed > 0 and random_value % 1000 < probability then speed - 1 else speed
